g.text: Left: synchronous request handlers (tRPC, route handlers). Right: durable Inngest functions. They never call each other —
they meet only in the data stores in the middle, including the event queue.
* duplicated external entity (drawn twice to avoid crossing lines). Every process also appends to the ops logs — guard_event, sandbox_event, throttle_window — not drawn.
Arrow direction = direction of data. Double-headed arrows read and write.
